articles.title: Fuel prices to be reviewed based on crude oil supply, says Union Minister Suresh Gopi
articles.titleEn: Fuel prices to be reviewed based on crude oil supply, says Union Minister Suresh Gopi
articles.summary: Union Minister of State for Petroleum and Natural Gas Suresh Gopi said the government will review fuel prices based on the availability of crude oil supplies. His remarks come amid recent increases in petrol, diesel and LPG prices following supply disruptions caused by the ongoing conflict in West Asia. He said Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri would take a call after assessing the situation.
